nodes.title: Number of $k$-Arndt compositions

nodes.title: Counting $k$-Arndt compositions for nonnegative $k$

nodes.summary: The numbers $a(5, k)$ of generalized Arndt compositions of $5$ (compositions $(c_1, \dots, c_m)$ of $5$ with $c_{2i-1} > c_{2i} + k$ whenever $2i \le m$) are $a(5, 0) = 5$, $a(5, -1) = 10$, $a(5, -2) = 14$ and $a(5, 1) = 3$.
nodes.title: Generalized Arndt counts for compositions of five

nodes.summary: For every natural number $j \ge 1$ and every natural number $n$, the number $a(n, -2j)$ of compositions $(c_1, \dots, c_m)$ of $n$ with $c_{2i-1} > c_{2i} - 2j$ whenever $2i \le m$ equals the number $c^{2j}_o(n)$ of compositions of $n$ in which every part is odd or at most $2j$. This includes $n = 0$.
nodes.title: Generalized Arndt compositions with negative even shift

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $j$ and $n$, the number $a(n, -2j - 1)$ of compositions $(c_1, \dots, c_m)$ of $n$ with $c_{2i-1} > c_{2i} - 2j - 1$ whenever $2i \le m$ equals the number $c^{2j+1}_e(n)$ of compositions of $n$ in which every part is even or at most $2j + 1$. This includes $n = 0$.
nodes.title: Generalized Arndt compositions with negative odd shift

nodes.title: Recurrences for generalized Arndt counts

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the number $a(n, 0)$ of Arndt compositions of $n$ (compositions $(c_1, \dots, c_m)$ of $n$ with $c_{2i-1} > c_{2i}$ whenever $2i \le m$) equals the number $c^0_o(n)$ of compositions of $n$ into odd parts. This includes $n = 0$, where both counts are $1$.
nodes.title: Arndt compositions and compositions into odd parts are equinumerous

nodes.summary: For an integer $k$ and a natural number $n$, $a(n, k)$ is the number of compositions $(c_1, \dots, c_m)$ of $n$, with any number $m \ge 0$ of parts, such that $c_{2i-1} > c_{2i} + k$ for every $i$ with $2i \le m$; a final unpaired part is unconstrained. The empty composition gives $a(0, k) = 1$, and $k = 0$ gives Arndt compositions.
nodes.title: Generalized Arndt compositions

nodes.summary: Let $c^{2k}_o(n)$ be the number of compositions of $n$ in which every part is odd or at most $2k$. Then $c^0_o(5) = 5$ and $c^2_o(5) = 14$.
nodes.title: Compositions of five into odd or small even parts

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $n$, $c^{2k}_o(n)$ is the number of compositions of $n$, with any number of parts, in which every part is odd or at most $2k$. For $k = 0$ these are De Morgan's compositions of $n$ into odd parts.
nodes.title: Compositions into odd or small even parts

nodes.summary: There is exactly one palindromic Arndt composition of $5$ with one part and middle summand $5$, exactly one with three parts and middle summand $1$, and none with three parts and middle summand $2$.
nodes.title: Palindromic Arndt compositions of 5

nodes.title: Reduced anti-palindromic compositions of 6 with three parts

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $n$ and $m$, the number of reduced anti-palindromic compositions of $n$ with $m$ parts equals the number of Arndt compositions of $n$ with $m$ parts, all positive integers being allowed as parts.
nodes.title: Arndt compositions and reduced anti-palindromic compositions are equinumerous

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $m$, this is the number of compositions $(\sigma_1, \ldots, \sigma_m)$ of $n$ into $m$ positive parts such that $\sigma_i > \sigma_{m+1-i}$ for every $i$ with $2i < m + 1$.
nodes.title: Reduced anti-palindromic compositions

nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 0$, the number of Arndt compositions of $n$ (compositions $(\sigma_1, \dots, \sigma_k)$ with $\sigma_{2i-1} > \sigma_{2i}$ whenever $2i \le k$) with all parts in $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$, counting the empty composition when $n = 0$, equals $N_{n+1}$, where $(N_m)$ is Narayana's cows sequence: $N_0 = 0$, $N_1 = N_2 = 1$ and $N_m = N_{m-1} + N_{m-3}$ for $m \ge 3$.
nodes.title: Arndt compositions with parts at most 4 and Narayana's cows sequence

Number Theory

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
